sql: SELECT r.year,r.round,c.name,st.status,re.laps FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) JOIN status st USING(status_id) JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959 AND d.forename='Bill' AND d.surname='Aston' ORDER BY r.year,r.round
